name: Sugar*Style
source:
Spring needs to be a more fun season!!!

Conned by an evil woman, my parents running away in the night after getting into debt... After a consecutive streak of trouble I was unable to decide on what to do after graduating. But then, I was helped by my kind relatives who introduced me to a local specialty school where I enrolled.

"This time I'll will enjoy my life!!"
And full of expectation in my chest, I reached the "Hidamari Dorm".

It turned out that it was a dorm where only women live in. It must be the place for my fateful encounter...! Is what I thought, but naturally, everyone was wary of me as the only man...!
But I won't give up...! This time, this spring, I will definitely enjoy myself!!

[Translated official introduction from [url=http://www.hook-net.jp/smee/sugarstyle/main/intro.html]the developer's site[/url]]
translation:
春天应该更加快乐！被邪恶女人欺骗、负债后连夜逃跑的父母，让主人公在一连串麻烦后无法决定毕业后该做什么。幸好，善良的亲戚帮助了他，把他介绍到当地一所特色专科学校，他于是进入那里学习。

“这一次，我要好好享受人生！”

胸怀满腔期待的他来到了“向阳宿舍”。

结果，那是一栋只住女性的宿舍。这里一定会成为命运邂逅的地点……他本来这么想，可作为唯一的男性，所有人自然都对他保持警惕。

但他不会放弃！这个春天，他一定要尽情享受！

[译自[url=http://www.hook-net.jp/smee/sugarstyle/main/intro.html]开发者官网[/url]]
